title: CJP seeks impartial probe into Chorabagan stampede that killed 19 in Bengal
description:
CJP's West Bengal unit on Saturday demanded an impartial probe into the Chorabagan stampede that claimed 19 lives and called for accountability for any negligence established during the investigation.
The party organised a condolence programme and a press conference to pay tribute to the victims and express solidarity with the affected families.
Addressing the press conference, a Cockroach Janta Party (CJP) member called for safety audits, trained personnel, emergency evacuation plans and better coordination among emergency services.
In a statement, CJP coordinator Prakriti Sahu outlined the party's demands, including timely financial assistance and medical support for the affected families and injured, stronger safety guidelines for major public gatherings and festival pandals across the state, and regular public updates on the investigation and relief measures.
The party said it would submit its demands in writing to the relevant authorities and seek details of the action taken.
